2124925957307826365.en_summary: $CRWD — BULL VS. BEAR CASE. Bull Case: Strong cybersecurity demand, 28.3% YoY revenue growth, raised full-year guidance, and expanding Falcon platform adoption support market share gains, stronger profitability, and long-term growth. Bear Case: Premium valuation, thin GAAP profitability, intense competition, and acquisition-related execution risks create downside pressure if growth slows or margins fail to expand.
2124925957307826365.zh_summary: $CRWD — 看多與看空案例。看多案例：強勁的網絡安全需求，28.3%同比收入增長，提高全年指引，以及擴展Falcon平台採用支持市場份額增長，更強的盈利能力，和長期增長。看空案例：溢價估值，薄弱的GAAP盈利能力，激烈競爭，以及收購相關執行風險如果增長放緩或利潤率未能擴展則造成下行壓力。
